description_en: Supports accurate detection of multi-format layouts, complex document backgrounds, and varying lighting environments. It enables detection after seal removal and supports advanced features such as low-confidence filtering and pattern Detection
description_zh: 支持多格式版面、复杂文档背景和光照环境的精准识别，可实现印章擦除后识别，支持低置信度过滤、图案检测等高阶功能
kebab_example: aliyun ocr-api recognize-advanced --url https://help-static-aliyun-doc.aliyuncs.com/file-manage-files/zh-CN/20241223/nognyw/%E5%85%A8%E6%96%87%E8%AF%86%E5%88%AB%E9%AB%98%E7%B2%BE%E7%89%88.png --biz-body '图片二进制文件' --output-char-info false --need-rotate false --output-table false --need-sort-page false --output-figure false --no-stamp false --paragraph false --row false --region cn-hangzhou
name: RecognizeAdvanced

parameters.help_en:
This field and the body field are mutually exclusive. You cannot pass through both fields simultaneously or leave both empty.
Image URL (must not exceed 2048 bytes; Base64 encoding is not supported)
parameters.help_zh:
本字段和body字段二选一，不可同时透传或同时为空。
图片链接（长度不超2048字节，不支持base64）
parameters.name: url

parameters.help_en:
You must specify either this field or the URL field, but not both, and neither can be empty.  
Binary file of the image, with a maximum size of 10 MB.  
When using HTTP invocation, upload the binary file in the HTTP body.  
When using the software development kit (SDK), place the image in the SDK body
parameters.help_zh:
本字段和URL字段二选一，不可同时透传或同时为空。
图片二进制文件，最大10MB。
使用HTTP方式调用，把图片二进制文件放到HTTP body中上传即可。
使用SDK的方式调用，把图片放到SDK的body中即可
parameters.name: body

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to output single-character recognition results. By default, this is not required.
true: required; false: not required
parameters.help_zh:
是否输出单字识别结果，默认不需要。
true：需要；false：不需要
parameters.name: output_char_info

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable automatic rotation. By default, this feature is disabled.  
true: enables the feature; false: disables the feature.
parameters.help_zh:
是否需要自动旋转功能，默认不需要。
true：需要；false：不需要
parameters.name: need_rotate

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to output table recognition results, including cell information. By default, this is not required.
true: required; false: not required
parameters.help_zh:
是否输出表格识别结果，包含单元格信息，默认不需要。
true：需要；false：不需要
parameters.name: output_table

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to output text blocks in sequential order. Default value: false.  
false: outputs text blocks from left to right and top to bottom; true: outputs text blocks from top to bottom and left to right.
parameters.help_zh:
是否按顺序输出文字块，默认为false。
false表示从左往右，从上到下的顺序；true表示从上到下，从左往右的顺序
parameters.name: need_sort_page

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable pattern Detection. By default, this feature is disabled.  
true: enables the feature; false: disables the feature.
parameters.help_zh:
是否需要图案检测功能，默认不需要。
true：需要；false：不需要
parameters.name: output_figure

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable stamp removal. By default, this feature is disabled.  
true: enables the feature; false: disables the feature.
parameters.help_zh:
是否需要去除印章功能，默认不需要。
true：需要；false：不需要
parameters.name: no_stamp

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether paragraph segmentation is required. By default, this is not required.
true: required; false: not required
parameters.help_zh:
是否需要分段功能，默认不需要。
true：需要；false：不需要
parameters.name: paragraph

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to return results line by line. By default, this feature is disabled.  
true: enables the feature; false: disables the feature.
parameters.help_zh:
是否需要成行返回功能，默认不需要。
true：需要；false：不需要
parameters.name: row

Code.description_en: Error code (this field is not returned if detection succeeded)
Code.description_zh: 错误码（如果识别成功，不会返回此字段）

Data.example: { 	"content": "2017年河北区实验小学", 	"height": 3509, 	"orgHeight": 3509, 	"orgWidth": 2512, 	"prism_version": "1.0.9", 	"prism_wnum": 126, 	"prism_wordsInfo": [{ 		"angle": -89, 		"direction": 0, 		"height": 541, 		"pos": [{ 			"x": 982, 			"y": 223 		}, { 			"x": 1522, 			"y": 223 		}, { 			"x": 1522, 			"y": 266 		}, { 			"x": 982, 			"y": 266 		}], 		"prob": 99, 		"width": 43, 		"word": "2017年河北区实验小学", 		"x": 1230, 		"y": -26 	}], 	"width": 2512 }

Message.description_en: Error message (this field is not returned if detection succeeded)
Message.description_zh: 错误提示（如果识别成功，不会返回此字段）
Message.example: You are not authorized to perform this operation.
